threads.label: Iran War Powers Conflict
threads.summary: House passed war powers resolution directing Trump to end Iran war with GOP crossovers; Trump vowed to veto calling it meaningless. Senate advanced similar measure but final vote unscheduled. Treasury issued 60-day sanctions waiver on Iranian oil as leverage. Iran denied nuclear inspections agreement while U.S. claimed confidence-building deal. Oil prices fell signaling possible de-escalation.
